mapper.sql: id, user_id, source_type, source_id, task_type, status, retry_count, error_code, error_message, idempotency_key, version, prompt_version, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_task (user_id, source_type, source_id, task_type, status, retry_count, idempotency_key, version, prompt_version) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sourceType, typeHandler=com.sangshen.aidiary.config.mybatis.AiTaskTypeHandlers$SourceTypeHandler}, #{sourceId}, #{taskType, typeHandler=com.sangshen.aidiary.config.mybatis.AiTaskTypeHandlers$TaskTypeHandler}, #{status, typeHandler=com.sangshen.aidiary.config.mybatis.AiTaskTypeHandlers$StatusHandler}, #{retryCount}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{version}, #{promptVersion})

INSERT IGNORE INTO ai_task (user_id, source_type, source_id, task_type, status, retry_count, idempotency_key, version, prompt_version) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sourceType, typeHandler=com.sangshen.aidiary.config.mybatis.AiTaskTypeHandlers$SourceTypeHandler}, #{sourceId}, #{taskType, typeHandler=com.sangshen.aidiary.config.mybatis.AiTaskTypeHandlers$TaskTypeHandler}, #{status, typeHandler=com.sangshen.aidiary.config.mybatis.AiTaskTypeHandlers$StatusHandler}, #{retryCount}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{version}, #{promptVersion})
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM ai_task WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRYING') ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_task SET status = 'SUCCESS', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, prompt_version = COALESCE(#{promptVersion}, prompt_version) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE ai_task SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_task SET status = 'RETRYING', finished_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED'
UPDATE ai_task SET status = 'CANCELLED', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, error_code = 'CANCELLED', error_message = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'RETRYING')

UPDATE ai_task SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = 0, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'SUCCESS', 'CANCELLED')
